subject: Analytics
question:
The angle theta is shown on the unit circle. Which pair consists of two expressions both equal to -cos(theta)?
Choices:
A:cos(pi+theta) and cos(pi-theta)
B:cos(pi+theta) and cos(pi/2-theta)
C:cos(pi/2-theta) and cos(2 pi-theta)
D:cos(pi-theta) and cos(2 pi-theta)
original_question:
Which two of the following expressions are OPPOSITE of $\cos (\theta)$ ? Choose 2 answers:
Choices:
A:$\cos (\pi+\theta)$
B:$\cos \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)$
C:$\cos (\pi-\theta)$
D:$\cos (2 \pi-\theta)$
